how_it_works.title: How iwoca works
points: Apply online in about 5 minutes — a few basic questions about you and your business.
Link your business accounts or upload bank statements / VAT returns / company accounts; iwoca assesses your business performance.
In almost all cases you get a decision within 24 hours — often within hours.
Once approved, draw down what you need to your bank account; funds typically arrive in hours.
You're only charged interest on what you actually draw down, for the days you use it.
Repay early any time — there are no fees for early repayment.
Borrowing over 12 months may incur an additional fee (typically 5% for 13-24 months, 6% for longer).

use_cases.title: What businesses use iwoca for
points: Working capital and smoothing cash flow between invoices.
Buying stock or inventory ahead of busy periods.
Equipment, vehicles and tools.
Expansion — new premises, new locations, growth projects.
Hiring staff.
Covering a VAT or tax bill.
Bridging gaps while waiting on customer payments.

comparison.title: How iwoca compares (iwoca's published positioning)
points: Speed: applying takes minutes and decisions usually arrive within 24 hours, versus the weeks a traditional bank process can take.
Flexibility: a Flexi-Loan works like a credit facility — draw down, repay, and top up within your approved limit, rather than a single fixed lump sum.
Pay for what you use: interest is charged only on drawn funds for the days used, and there are no early-repayment fees.
Unsecured with no asset requirements; a personal guarantee from a director is required for limited companies.
Eligibility is broad: no minimum turnover or trading history stated (startups capped around £10,000).
[VERIFY] Any named side-by-side comparison against a specific lender should be checked against that lender's current terms before use.

rates_and_fees.title: Rates and fees
points: iwoca's representative rate is 3.3% per month (interest quoted per 30 days).
Your actual rate is based on your business and confirmed after assessment — any rate shown before applying is a rough estimate, not a guarantee.
Interest is charged daily on your outstanding balance, so each repayment's interest portion falls as the balance reduces.
No fees for early repayment — settle any time and pay interest only up to that day.
Borrowing over 12 months may incur an additional fee (typically 5% for 13-24 months, 6% for longer).

eligibility.title: Who can apply
points: UK-based business.
Limited company or LLP / partnership (iwoca states it no longer lends to sole traders).
Applicant aged 18 or over.
No minimum turnover and no minimum trading history stated; startups with no trading history are capped around £10,000.
Borrow £1,000 to £1,000,000; credit limits are typically up to around two months' turnover.
